title: OutThink AI Monthly Benchmark: Where Frontier AI Still Breaks (October 2026)
headline: Licensed Professionals Defeat Leading Frontier AI Models in Over 78% of Real-World Edge Scenarios
executiveSummary: In this month's OutThink AI Human Edge Index, interventional medicine and cross-border commercial law demonstrated the highest resilience against state-of-the-art AI reasoning models. While models exhibit near-perfect performance on standard licensing board exams, real-world atypical multi-factor anomalies continue to trigger catastrophic overconfidence errors.

pressTakeaway: OutThink AI's private evaluation dataset demonstrates that academic benchmarks dramatically underestimate AI error rates in high-stakes professional practice. All test items remain cryptographically sealed to prevent dataset contamination.
